description: Hitachi Energy (ABB) REx5xx REL511 distance zones as a flat REL511 setting sheet prints them (TAP NAME | TAP SETTING | TAP RANGE). Catalog-only, verified subset: per-zone Operation_Zn (status), DirZn (direction), gated Timer tn / tn, X1Zn (reactive reach), R1Zn, X0Zn / R0Zn, RFNZn as printed, the CT / VT values and the line data. Not interpreted (owner-verified semantics missing): the characteristic, the impedance basis, the RF loop / per-phase convention (RFZn is preserved, never used as +R), the ZnBlock switches and any directional / left boundary.
interpretation_notes: Zone N is the parameter set ending in ZN (Operation_ZN, X1ZN, R1ZN, X0ZN, R0ZN, RFZN, RFNZN, Timer tN, tN, DirZN, ZNBlock); the numbering follows the sheet.
The sheet does not name the zone characteristic and does not state whether the impedance settings are primary or secondary ohms: neither is assumed (Missing).

RFZn is the phase-phase fault-resistance setting. Whether it is a per-loop or a per-phase value is not established for this relay family, so no Right Resistive Reach (+R) is derived from it; it is preserved with the zone. RFNZn is kept as printed as the earth resistive reach (not plotted).
No left (-R) boundary or directional-element geometry is stated; none is assumed. ZnBlock switches are preserved uninterpreted.

zone_preserved.reason: ZnBlock is an On / Off switch whose effect (what it blocks) the sheet does not state; it is preserved and does not decide the zone's state.

mappings.note: CTPrim Iphases: the phase CT primary current (no unit printed; amperes).
Ir is the relay's rated current input; it is taken as the CT secondary rating. The sheet does not label it as the CT secondary (the notes' CT ratio agrees). Confirm.
VTPrim Uphases is printed without a unit; kV is assumed (the sheet's 132kV header agrees) and converted to volts. Confirm the unit.
Ur is the relay's rated voltage input; it is taken as the VT secondary rating (volts). The sheet does not label it as the VT secondary. Confirm.
Line Length as printed; its unit is the sheet's 'Length unit'.
R1 / X1 of the line-data group (beside Line Length and the fault-locator source impedances) read as the line's positive-sequence impedance; the sheet's own '1' / '0' naming, not a stated label.
R0 / X0 of the line-data group read as the line's zero-sequence impedance; the sheet's own '1' / '0' naming, not a stated label.
DirZn as printed. A value that is not one of the printed options (Non / Forward / Reverse) is not interpreted.
The sheet states a reactance (X1Zn) and resistances, never a reach angle: the reach is stated as orthogonal R / X values.
X1Zn: the zone's positive-sequence reactive reach.
R1Zn: the zone's positive-sequence resistance setting. How the relay uses it is not stated; it does not set a drawn boundary.
R0Zn / X0Zn: the zone's zero-sequence reach. Preserved, not plotted.

gap.note: The sheet states the phase-phase fault-resistance setting ({evidence}), but whether it is a per-loop or a per-phase value is not established for this relay family. No Right Resistive Reach (+R) is derived from it (no division, no as-printed use); the value is preserved here.

mappings.note: RFNZn, the phase-earth fault-resistance setting, kept as printed (not scaled). Its per-loop / per-phase convention is not stated. The phase-phase engine does not draw it.

requires.off_note: The 'Timer t{n}' switch is Off, so t{n} is not an operating delay of this zone; none is assumed.
requires.missing_note: the 'Timer t{n}' switch was not found, so t{n} is not established as in use

mappings.note: The zone timer, read only while its own 'Timer' switch is On. One delay per zone (phase and earth loops).
